Subject: Quick follow-up — incident notification cadence & artifacts needed

Hi Lucia — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can keep the PoC timeline moving: 

- Confirm SOC 2 status: do you have a Type II report now or an audit window scheduled? If available, can you share the report month/year (or an expected delivery date)?
- Regulatory constraints: you mentioned HIPAA applicability — do you require a signed BAA from Redwood for this project?
- Incident notification expectations: what notification windows do you need for critical / high / medium incidents (hours)? Any contractual SLA thresholds we should model in the draft MSA?
- Evidence/DR artifacts: to satisfy your security and legal teams we typically provide a small set of artifacts. Could you confirm which of the following you want first: DR runbook excerpt, RTO/RPO matrix, tabletop exercise summary, or incident post-mortem template?
- Vendor questionnaire: if you prefer, send over your security questionnaire (or a link) and we can begin populating — otherwise we can kick off our standard SSQ.

Next steps I propose: I can pull our IR playbook excerpt + a short SOC 2 summary and a BCP sample table and share those with you and legal. If that looks good we can book a 30-min security review next week to walk through details.

Deliverable ask: please confirm SOC2 timing, whether a BAA is required, and the notification windows you expect.

Thanks —
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
pri yom@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0194

Thanks, Priyom — good call today. A few clarifications from our side: 

- SOC 2: we're mid-audit. Targeting Type II issuance in Q1 2027 (final report expected by 2027-03). We can share a SOC 2 readiness summary now if that helps.
- HIPAA / BAA: yes, we will need a BAA for PHI processing tied to the PoC. Please send your standard BAA or the DocuSign link and I will route to our legal.
- Notification windows: for our vendors we require: Critical = notification within 4 hours; High = notification within 12 hours; Medium = 48 hours (these are our operational expectations; contract language can be adjusted).
- Artifacts: Legal asked for a DR runbook excerpt, RTO/RPO table, and a recent tabletop summary (if available). A redacted incident post-mortem template is helpful but lower priority.

I'll also include our Security Ops contact (alex.chen@medpoint.ai) and Legal (legal@medpoint.ai) on any artifacts you send. Can you drop the documents into a shared link or send them directly?

Appreciate the quick turnaround —
Lucia Morales

- High: initial notification within 4 hours
- Medium: initial notification within 24-48 hours depending on impact

We can make the Critical window 1 hour, but I understand MedPoint asked for 4 hours. If legal/commercial want to accept MedPoint's 4h Critical requirement for the scope of this pilot, that's a negotiable contract exception — flag to me if you want to commit. Otherwise we should propose Redwood defaults above.
